name: Kerala Ayurveda Ltd
tagline: Ayurvedic products and wellness-services company in severe financial distress — deeply negative returns, losses still widening, near-zero interest coverage
business_overview: Kerala Ayurveda Ltd makes classical and proprietary Ayurvedic medicines and personal-care products and runs Ayurveda wellness centres and academies in India and abroad (part of the Katra Group).
fundamentals_table: Q1 FY27 revenue +16% to ~Rs 33 Cr; operating EBITDA loss ~halved to ~Rs 3.8 Cr
Low interest coverage; trading ~22x book (tiny book value)
fundamentals_narrative: The old 108-stock screen flagged AVOID on severe distress (ROE -117.5%, interest coverage 0.07x, debt/EBITDA >15x, widening losses). Current data is no better and on some measures worse: ROE about -183%, three-year ROE about -85%, PAT still deeply negative. Q1 FY27 shows revenue up ~16% and the EBITDA loss roughly halved — a marginal narrowing, not a turnaround. Interest coverage remains weak and book value is tiny.
technical_read: Not independently pulled; stock down ~62% over one year.
sentiment_summary: No ValuePickr thread found in a category-11/14/17 search (Step 3.05). topic_slug set to null; web-only write-up. Filtered at the preliminary stage on red-flag grounds — no deep read.
community_signal: None — no dedicated VP thread, no trusted-roster coverage.
bse_notes: Independent financial media has previously described an 'operational crisis' at the company. Not re-verified this pass.
bull_case: Recognised brand in branded Ayurveda / wellness with domestic and overseas presence
Q1 FY27 revenue +16% and EBITDA loss roughly halved — direction of the most recent quarter is slightly less bad
bear_case: ROE about -183%, three-year ROE about -85%, ROCE about -0.5% — severe, sustained value destruction
Still loss-making (~ -Rs 26 Cr) with losses that have been widening, not narrowing, at the annual level
Low interest coverage — operating profit cannot service debt
Tiny book value; stock still down ~62% over the year
The Q1 improvement is a marginal loss-narrowing off a very low base, not evidence of a fixed cost structure
verdict_headline: AVOID — severe, ongoing financial distress; the small Q1 loss-narrowing is not a turnaround
verdict_reasoning: Re-check of a legacy-108-screen seed; the old 2026-08-15 AVOID call still holds and, on ROE, is arguably worse now (~-183% vs -117.5%)
Losses are continuing and interest coverage remains near zero — a going-concern-adjacent risk profile
A single quarter of +16% revenue with a halved (still negative) EBITDA is not enough to lift the red-flag tier
red_flag_reason: ROE about -183% (3-yr ~-85%), continuing net losses, near-zero interest coverage and a history of widening losses — severe financial distress.
